title: CMake policy versions older than 3.5 are removed
summary: CMake 4.0 removed compatibility with policy versions older than 3.5. A cmake_minimum_required(VERSION) or cmake_policy(VERSION) call that does not set the policy version to at least 3.5 (optionally via ...<policy_max>) produces an error on CMake 4.0 and newer. CMake 4.0.0 was published on 2025-03-27.
replacement: cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5) or newer, or VERSION <min>...<max> with <max> at least 3.5

sources.title: CMake 4.0 release notes (compatibility older than 3.5 removed)

constraints: Raising the policy version can change NEW policy behavior; read the policies introduced between the old and new floor before committing.
Projects that must still configure on older CMake can use VERSION <min>...<max> so the minimum stays low while the policy max is at least 3.5 on newer CMake.

steps.title: Raise the reported cmake_minimum_required policy version
steps.instructions: Change the reported cmake_minimum_required(VERSION …) so the effective policy version is at least 3.5 (for example VERSION 3.16, or VERSION 2.8.12...3.16).

verification.purpose: Configure the project with a CMake 4.x toolchain and confirm the policy floor is accepted.
